title: Management and Conservation of the Environment
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Walk the school compound and list signs of degradation (bare patches, gullies, litter) before the lesson.

skills.key_step: The child names causes and effects of environmental degradation and designs measures to manage and conserve the environment.

floor.question: Give one way to conserve vegetation.

steps: Say who can carry it out.

board.do: Draw a bare slope with a gully.

board.say: What caused this, and how can we stop it?

board.do: Wait for "no cover; plant grass and trees, terraces".

misconceptions.ask: Which is an effect of degradation?
misconceptions.repair: Show a gully photo and ask what happened to the soil.

misconceptions.ask: Which helps to conserve the environment?
misconceptions.repair: Compare land after burning with land after tree planting.

listen_for: It is harmless, it does not rot
misconceptions.ask: Why is plastic waste harmful to the environment?
misconceptions.repair: Show a blocked drain and a cow that ate plastic.

checks.question: Give two causes of environmental degradation.
checks.answer: any two of: deforestation, overgrazing, pollution, poor farming

checks.question: Give one measure to conserve the environment.
checks.answer: any of: planting trees, terracing, recycling, laws, controlled grazing
